name: trace
description: TRACE — Temporal Web Intelligence Engine. See how the internet changes.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n web,api,worker -c peach,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @trace/web" "npm run dev -w @trace/api" "npm run dev -w @trace/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @trace/shared && npm run build -w @trace/config && npm run build -w @trace/database && npm run build -w @trace/diff-engine && npm run build -w @trace/crawler && npm run build -w @trace/ai
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trace/shared && npm run build -w @trace/config && npm run build -w @trace/database && npm run build -w @trace/diff-engine && npm run build -w @trace/crawler && npm run build -w @trace/ai && npm run build -w @trace/api && npm run build -w @trace/worker && npm run build -w @trace/web
